text: Multiple cash deposits or withdrawals just below the $10,000 reporting threshold may indicate structuring under 31 U.S.C. § 5324(a)(3).
31 U.S.C. § 5324(a)(3) prohibits structuring transactions to evade currency transaction reporting. Examiners should document patterns of sub-CTR deposits and counterparty concentration.
Layering involves moving illicit funds through a series of transactions designed to disguise origin. (case 0060)
